prompts.name: 战前确认_五对五_v3
prompts.prompt:
Generate one polished full-screen 16:9 Chinese cultivation game UI ideal mockup at 1672x941 composition. Consistent with the EXISTING BATTLE UI: muted dark ink-teal translucent panels (#1b3031), thin matte aged beige-gray edging (#c4b58c), extremely modest small corner cloud motifs, warm ivory Chinese text (#f4f0df), ink-wash texture. Behind interface a subdued warm ochre stone terrace with blue-gray mountains and muted pine trees. NOT a different parchment-book interface: primary panels MUST be DARK TEAL, NOT LARGE CREAM PAPER SHEETS. Cream paper only inside small square portrait or item thumbnails. Absolutely NO shiny gold, thick bronze frames, bright yellow typography, western fantasy, glowing sci-fi, ornate oversized calligraphy. Small heading like the existing battle title; refined readable Chinese serif font, compact calm professional game UI. All labels stay inside safe insets, no overlap, no tiny illegible text, no characters standing behind UI; portraits inside rows only. Colored accents: green energy flame, blue mana droplet; red only health loss/defeat; ivory normal labels. Every position is intentional, realistic reusable scalable UI widgets. No experience bar, new currency, invented rewards, fake retry/paid revive. This is concept art, all stats/items illustrative. Do not put developer wording into game UI. No collage.
PRE-BATTLE 5 VERSUS 5 SCREEN. Central panel occupies x8%-92%, y12%-88%. Top header '山谷遭遇 · 战前确认' modest 30px. Below two EQUAL columns separated by fine vertical line, each ~620px wide. Headers '我方 5人' and '敌方 5人'. Exactly FIVE equal-height compact character rows per column, all five visible simultaneously. Each row has 58px square cream-paper illustrated portrait at left, to its right name/realm first line, HP slim framed bar and numbers second line, speed and escape speed third line. NO enormous portrait or full-body card. Left five unique male/female cultivator head portraits names '林清远','叶轻舟','苏墨','陈云川','白芷'; small subdued '玩家' tag only 林清远, '同伴' tags other four. Example labels '云息一层', '生命 192/192', '速度 110', '遁速 100'. Right five different rugged bandit head portraits names '盗匪头目','持刀盗匪','弓手盗匪','山道盗匪','游荡盗匪'; realm '凡人', HP and speed varied sensible example numbers. Unit name emphasis ivory, health green or muted cinnabar small bar. A shallow separate summary strip BELOW the 5-row lists showing '每轮行动 5' | '目标 击败敌方' | '撤退 可尝试'. Footer outside list with centered primary '开始战斗', secondary '查看属性'. Panel title/footer and spacing clean, all 10 units visible and clearly belong to their side. Leave 16px inside border around every row, avoid edge decorations. Similar thin-edged queue-panel visual language to combat. One full landscape UI.

LEFT: header '参战状况', compact tabs '我方 5' selected and '敌方 5'. Exactly five vertically stacked equal-height rows, all visible: square 48px portraits, names 林清远,叶轻舟,苏墨,陈云川,白芷, HP before-to-after numbers such as '192 → 156 / 192' beneath names, and small muted text '外伤 1 · 内伤 0' or '状态正常'. RIGHT: header '战利品', right header text '共48种'. BELOW header a fixed-height clipped INDEPENDENT scrollable grid, exactly SIX COLUMNS, THREE fully visible ROWS plus a narrow partial FOURTH ROW clipped at bottom to show additional content. Each tile a small dark teal square with thin beige edge, cream-paper item thumbnail 64x64 and short centered Chinese item name below, quantity in bottom-right corner of icon. Hand-painted material icons: hide, bone, ore, herb sprigs, wood, cloth, feathers, fangs, seeds, mushrooms, mineral crystals, worn manuals; restrained natural multicolor icons, no loud rarity borders. Clearly visible vertical scrollbar at far right of loot panel with thumb occupying about one third height and track continuing; a small subtle down chevron at bottom. Header remains above clipping viewport; scrollbar NEVER extends into footer. A short hint below grid '滚动查看全部战利品'.
BOTTOM FIXED FOOTER outside BOTH sections: small text '行囊放不下的物品将保留待领', centered primary '收取并返回' and secondary '查看详情'. Buttons remain visible regardless loot scroll. Emphasize realistic ability to handle dozens of item types, not a three-item reward showcase, not whole-page scrolling. One full screen.
